title: Glasgow Coma Scale in 60 Seconds (E4 V5 M6)
description:
The Glasgow Coma Scale scores eyes (1-4), verbal (1-5) and motor (1-6), for a total of 3 to 15. The lowest score is 3, not 0. In head injury, a GCS of 8 or less is a classic sign the airway needs protecting (NICE NG232).

Sources:
• StatPearls: Glasgow Coma Scale (NBK513298): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30020670/
• NICE NG232: Head injury, assessment and early management: https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng232
• The Glasgow Coma Scale: 50-year anniversary. Neurol Sci 2024: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38436790/
